title: B: missed arrays lecture
persona: A diligent CS 3410 student who missed the lecture on arrays (and pointers) and wants to catch up from the readings before Prelim 1 on Oct 15. You keep asking where values actually live in memory: where the array is, where each element is, what a pointer holds, stack versus heap. You follow along, sometimes ask a side question, and try the checks the tutor gives you.
